explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1111 (the El-Zahar–Erdős question): for t, c ≥ 1 there is d such that every finite graph with χ ≥ d and ω < t (CliqueFree t) has disjoint anticomplete A, B with χ(G[A]), χ(G[B]) ≥ c. Requiring both chromatic numbers to be at least c is equivalent to χ(A) ≥ χ(B) ≥ c after swapping. The open question is stated affirmatively.
